brief:
Amirah 'Emad Rezeq al-'Arabiyah, 35, has spent more than two years searching for her son since the war began on October 7, 2023. She remained in her home in al-Zaytoun neighborhood, Gaza City, until October 29, 2023, when intensifying bombardment forced her to flee the area, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported.

Al-'Arabiyah's account documents the ongoing toll of displacement and loss on Gaza's civilian population since the start of the conflict. Thousands of Palestinians remain separated from missing relatives with no resolution to their cases.

title: Gaza mother endures two and a half years without her missing son
